angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 7,278,666 km at 163.19 pc = 0.6 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1278 +/- 0.0142 mas (same row, RUWE 0.80): 163.19 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 10.462 (10.250 to 10.673) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 7,278,666 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.003 (2.963 to 3.043) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4860 +/- 8.4 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1700658653802527104: teff_gspphot 4860.1943 K (16th-84th percentiles 4845.6187-4862.3267), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1700658653802527104: teff_gspphot 4860.1943 K (16th-84th percentiles 4845.6187-4862.3267), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/baekdu.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.876, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 8 UMi (pscomppars): spectral type K0, from Lee et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...584A..79L/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * 8 UMi: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 8 UMi (pscomppars): [m/H] -0.03 dex, from Hon et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023Natur.618..917H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 8 UMi (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.72346, from Hon et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023Natur.618..917H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 8 UMi (pscomppars): age 1.7 Gyr, from Lee et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...584A..79L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 8 UMi (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.6 km/s, from Lee et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...584A..79L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
